name: Blueconic Block (Most Popular)
description: Component set · Variant: Device = Desktop, Mobile · reused as instances in the assembled Desktop and Mobile pages and in both raw section libraries.
responsiveRules: Device=1024 / 1100 / 1280 are the content column only; the ad sits in the template's rail. Device=Desktop (full width, no rail) is not used by any template.
